messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: billing.tally.drift (severity: P2). Token-count delta > 15% on aggregator-eu for last 30m. Auto-notify oncall.
ops-oncall: Oncall here, looking into it. Reassigning to sam for initial triage. :eyes:
sam_laing: seeing a sharp bump in token emissions from emitter-proxy-eu starting ~1967893200. +18% vs baseline. Dashboards: https://redwood.internal/dash/agg-eu (private)
maria_gonzalez: multiple customers received overage flags and push-notices. CS queue has 2 tickets citing unexpected charges.
devon_ops: grabbing quick logs. running query to compare raw emitter counts vs tally:
```
SELECT emitter_id, count(*) as tokens, window
FROM token_emitter_eu
WHERE ts >= to_timestamp(1967891200)
GROUP BY emitter_id, window
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
devon_ops: sample output:
```
emitter-17  1,920,342
emitter-09  1,918,999
emitter-remote 2,101,234  <-- duplicate replays
```
kevin_billing: is this duplication new after last deploy? any recent rollouts to emitter-proxy-eu?
sam_laing: there was a small hotfix last night to proxy retry logic (deploy 1967889000). Might be related. I'm seeing message-id dupes in logs.
claire_support: flagged 2 customers with invoices auto-emailed this morning. I've paused outgoing billing-notify for EU tenants.
ops-oncall: good. temporarily muting overage alerts for billing.tally.drift to avoid noise. Keep CS blocked from automated emails until we confirm impact.
incidents-bot: Action: muted alerts billing.overage for 1h (triggered by ops-oncall).
devon_ops: starting a targeted recompute on a sample account to confirm reconciliation behavior.
```
# recompute command
POST /internal/billing/recompute
{ "tenant": "tenant-503", "window_start": 1967836800, "window_end": 1967894400 }
```
devon_ops: recompute job started job_id=rb-1967894387. logs show pre-recompute tokens=1,234,567 post-recompute tokens=1,005,432 => ~18% drop (duplicates removed).
kevin_billing: ok that matches what we thought. Likely duplicate replay at emitter layer. We should run a rolling backfill for last 48h with dedupe rules.
sam_laing: working on a hotfix to disable retry path that introduced dupes. I'll push a quick patch to emitter-proxy and roll to EU only. Plan: deploy to canary(1 node) -> monitor 10m -> roll.
ops-oncall: go for canary. Notify when patch is live.
incidents-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: emitter-proxy-eu:canary@1967894620 by sam_laing.
sam_laing: canary up. traffic routed. watching metrics. so far emitter replays dropped to 0.5% within 3m.
maria_gonzalez: CS update draft: "We're aware of duplicate token counts causing transient overage flags for a subset of EU customers. We're recomputing affected billing windows and will credit impacted billing items. More updates in 1h." Want me to send now or wait for reconciliation results? :thinking:
kevin_billing: wait for automated recompute batch on a larger sample (10 tenants) to verify scale before sending customer comms.
devon_ops: kicked off backfill job: backfill_id=bf-1967894722 for last 48h across EU shards. Estimated completion 2h. Using dedupe policy v2 (--dedupe-window=30s).
claire_support: put all affected tickets into a private queue #billing-incident-EU and added template for credits.
ops-oncall: good. also scheduling an immediate temporary credit hold: accounting-bot, please create a billing hold for flagged invoices in EU region.
accounting-bot: Created hold rule HLD-1967894750: block invoice finalization for tenants with overage_flag=true AND region=eu. Applied to 42 tenants. :white_check_mark:
sam_laing: rolling emitter-proxy fix to EU fleet (gradual). Will monitor for duplicate events and token deltas.
incidents-bot: metric alert: token_delta_eu dropped from +18% to +1.2% after canary.
kevin_billing: timeline recap for postmortem: root cause likely retry logic regression in emitter-proxy (deploy 1967889000). Mitigation: hotfix + recompute + hold invoice finalization + credits. Impact: ~42 tenants flagged, 6 customer support tickets, no confirmed charge yet (holds in place).
claire_support: field ops: prepare customer credit amounts approx ~avg $12 invoice delta. I'll assemble list for finance.
devon_ops: backfill progress: 15% complete. no errors so far. logs show duplicates filtered by dedupe policy.
maria_gonzalez: can we run a sweep to clear overage flags once recompute finishes? prefer automated clear vs manual CS patching.
ops-oncall: yes. add task: /run billing/clear_overage_flags --backfill-id=bf-1967894722 (post-success)
incidents-bot: scheduled task queued clear_overage_flags for backfill bf-1967894722.
sam_laing: can confirm canary looked good, rolling complete. patch deployed at 1967895020.
ops-oncall: handing off to oncall-shift2 for monitoring and postmortem creation. @kevin_billing and @claire_support please own customer comms and credits. Tagging infra for follow-up.
kevin_billing: acknowledged. I'll draft credit report and send to finance.
claire_support: acknowledged. prepping CS messages and ticket templates.
ops-oncall: closing incident channel in 1h unless backfill shows further issues. Postmortem owner: sam_laing.
incidents-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (P2). Backfill in progress. Next update 1967896120.
